general.title: Bank of Canada Warns of Broadening Inflation; Bonds Decline
general.summary: The head of the Bank of Canada warned that higher oil costs will be passed on to consumers as the economy holds up better than officials expected.

Iraq Rejects OPEC+ Assessment of Its Oil Production Capacity
general.summary: Iraq has rejected an assessment of its oil production capacity commissioned by OPEC+, according to people familiar with the matter, setting up a potential clash at this weekend’s key meeting on production targets.

Consumer Confidence Surges as Americans Grow More Optimistic
general.summary: The Conference Board’s gauge of confidence increased 11.4 points to 103.3, the highest since January 2025, data released Tuesday showed. That topped all estimates in a Bloomberg survey of economists. Michael Ball reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

general.title: Colombia Fiscal Bill Likely to Fall Short, Still Deliver Big Fix
general.summary: Colombia’s economic rescue bill is set to deliver an “unprecedented” fiscal adjustment even if it falls short of the government’s target, according to a key lawmaker in the ruling coalition.

general.title: New Trump Tariffs Won’t Top Trade Deal Levels, Will Be Targeted
general.summary: President Donald Trump’s next round of tariffs won’t surpass levels set in US trade deals he’s negotiated and will be targeted for each economy rather than imposed as a blanket rate, according to people familiar with an announcement coming as soon as Tuesday.

general.title: Kalshi Users Under 21 Lost $8.9 Million in NYC, Probe Finds
general.summary: Over 50,000 people between the ages of 18 and 21 are using Kalshi in New York City, and they are losing money at a disproportionate rate, according to internal data that Kalshi released to the New York City Council.

general.title: Brazil Real Gains on Reports Lula Backs More Spending Curbs
general.summary: The Brazilian real rallied by the most in nearly two months on reports that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is backing moves to curb fiscal spending, easing the concerns about the budget deficit that have dragged the currency down since his surprise re-election.

general.title: US Consumer Confidence Surges to Highest Since Early 2025
general.summary: US consumer confidence surged in November to the highest in nearly two years as Americans grew more optimistic about the economy and the job market.

general.title: Venezuela Puts Debt at $237 Billion Ahead of Historic Overhaul
general.summary: Venezuela’s government said public debt stood at $237.5 billion in 2025, giving investors the first snapshot into its finances in years and setting the stage for what could be one of the largest sovereign debt restructurings in history. Bonds jumped.

general.title: Best Buy reports comparable sales growth of 6.1%, highest in five years
general.summary: Best Buy beat quarterly expectations for its fiscal third-quarter earnings results on Tuesday and raised its full-year guidance.

general.title: Signal joins United Airlines, banks in limiting AI agents over customer risks
general.summary: Privacy-focused messaging application Signal has joined United Airlines and JPMorgan Chase in implementing restrictions around artificial intelligence agents.
